fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of travel on the street.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clear sightlines for vehicles approaching and entering the property.
• Clear overhanging branches along the access drive to allow emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Thin dense vegetation near the structure to create open space between plantings and exterior walls.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles, equipment, or debris to allow emergency vehicles to reach the structure.
• Cut back dense vegetation that limits visibility of the main entrance from the street or driveway.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly so responders can identify it quickly from the street under low-light or smoky conditions.
• Maintain a clear, unobstructed path along the walkway from the driveway to the main entrance.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees in the cluster closest to the structure to create more open space between the canopy and the building.
• Trim lower branches on large trees near the structure to lift the canopy higher off the ground.
• Remove shrubs and smaller plants growing directly against or touching the structure's exterior walls.
• Separate shrubs from one another where they are grouped close together near the structure to reduce how fire could move between them.
• Cut back mixed vegetation on all sides of the structure where plants are within a few feet of the walls.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation so vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Remove any dead material within the scattered shrubs near the structure.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure so there is open ground visible between their canopies.
• Keep the area immediately surrounding the structure mowed or cleared so low vegetation does not connect the surrounding plants to the building.
• Mark the entrance to the single access route clearly so it is easy to locate for emergency vehicles.
